summary: Sandbox create-session, get-session, stats, get-operation, and terminate all worked against the live TEE environment, but execute failed at runtime. The API returned 200 with data.success=false, PostgreSQL recorded the operation as failed, and attached log evidence from zkme-dev/credbridge shows nsjail policy construction around the same run window; the execute error reported a seccomp policy compilation failure and browser runtime exit status 255.
contract_findings: POST /api/v1/sandbox/sessions/:id/execute returned HTTP 200 even though the embedded operation result had success=false and the operation later resolved to status=failed.
The execute error body reported `Could not compile policy` and `Couldn't prepare sandboxing policy` with process exit status 255.
GET /api/v1/sandbox/stats reported `healthy=true` while also carrying `error=Insufficient warm instances`.
Attached Loki evidence from zkme-dev/credbridge shows the deployed service constructing nsjail `--seccomp_string` payloads for sandbox session creation in the same run window.
